policy: Human research decisions are independent of Overture exports and generated data. Online Google Maps name searches corroborate possible listing presence only, never field verification, public parking rights or current operation. Three user-supplied Google Maps coordinate-pin links are recorded solely as navigation references for physical inspections; they do not prove a facility name, entrance or access. No Google Maps place details, reviews, hours or provider-derived coordinates were imported. Excluded records are retained pending documented reasons. No automatic publication.
